text:
Nina: Short thread to decide Optimize toolkit GA scope. Two big asks: batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. Need one clear GA plan.
Owen: My vote: ship recommendations + alerts but manual apply only. keep rollback/fallback simple.
Pri: agree. For quant recs we should require a quick fidelity pass: median quality delta < 2% on the canonical suite, otherwise mark for review.
Ken: customers want audit rows and weekly CSV exports. Also one pilot insists on manual approval before any changes on Dedicated.
Nina: Proposed GA must-haves: 1) Recs API (read-only) + rationale text 2) Eval-alert webhook + simple inbox UI 3) Audit events + CSV export 4) Manual-only apply for GA.
Owen: rollout config example: `apply_mode: manual`, `audience: 0%->pilot-only`, `alarms: quality_delta > 0.05 || latency_p95 > 1.5x`. we'll start feature-flagged.
Pri: fidelity check CLI: `eval_tool --suite=canon --baseline=prod --threshold=2pct` ; quant suggestions labeled PASS / REVIEW.
Ken: CS will only sign pilots if we provide 90-day audit retention + weekly CSV. I'll get confirmation from the pilot customers.
Nina: decision call: manual-only GA. opt-in auto-apply is a Q2 roadmap item after pilot signoffs.
Owen: I'll drop a minimal API contract and a deploy plan (flag: optimize_toolkit_v1=false) by EOD.
Pri: will share the eval harness and thresholds tomorrow.
ops-bot: scheduled staging deploy with feature-flag for 2024-05-02T01:00Z
Nina: thanks everyone — closing after API contract posted. Ping here if blocked.
